name: Bow Note
summary: A gift wrap step where the box wraps itself in your paper, ties the ribbon and hangs your note
about: A checkout gift option with a live preview. Switching gift wrap on folds patterned paper round a plain box flap by flap, runs the ribbon both ways, pops a bow and swings a paper tag in on its string. The tag shows your note and name as you type, papers re-wrap the box, ribbons are re-tied, a gift receipt can hide the prices, and the PKR 250 fee shows in the total.
how: Flip the gift wrap switch: the paper folds round the box, the ribbon wraps and the bow pops
Pick one of four papers or three ribbons; the box unwraps and wraps again in the new choice
Type a note and your name: they appear on the hanging tag, which swings when you pause
Switch on the gift receipt to leave the prices out of the box
Press Save gift options: the box hops, the bow tightens and hearts float up
